title.narrative: Civil Aviation Development Investment Program - Project 1

description.narrative: The program involves upgrading and rehabilitation of airports identified under project 1: (i) Wewak, (ii) Hoskins, (iii) Gurney, (iv) Mt. Hagen, and (v) Jackson's domestic airport. The first tranche will finance the following under project 1: (i) Improvements in pavements and fencing identified as requiring emergency works to comply with ICAO safety and security standards; (ii) Support for (a) engineering design, preparation of bid documents, and procurement by the NAC; and (b) preparation by the NAC of investment proposals for subsequent projects and tranches for ADB approval; and (iii) Consulting services to NAC for the supervision of (a) airport improvement contracts for the five project 1 airports, and (b) long-term maintenance contracts for these five airports. In addition to the five airports, two others (Kavieng and Goroka) will have new security fences installed.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 2588: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 2589: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 2590: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: Remaining civil works contracts for Mt. Hagen Terminal and Hoskins Airport Upgrade completed. Both facilities were inaugurated in Q4, 2015.
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2009: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//43141-png-seia.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: A. Restructuring of former CAA is completed. Three separate entities - National Airports Corporation, PNG Air Services Ltd and Civil Aviation Safety Authority - have been established. The three institutions are fully operational.
B. In March 2012, the Security fencing construction work in Kavieng was completed. The Port Moresby airport apron extension contract signed in May 2012 was completed in September 2013. NAC signed the contract for security fencing work at Hoskins, Goroka, Wewak and Gurney airport in August 2012. All physical works were completed in September 2013. The contract for Hoskins Airport Upgrade of the runway was signed by NAC on the 22 April 2013. NAC issued possession of site and paid mobilization advance to the contractor in June 2013. Construction completed Q3, 2015.
NAC signed the contract for Mt. Hagen terminal in April 2013. NAC issued possession of site and paid mobilization advance to the contractor in June 2013. Construction works were completed in Q3, 2015.
C. NAC is formulating initial work for asset management to be implemented during tranche 2 of the MFF.
PNG Air Services Ltd commissioned the Port Moresby Instrument Landing System (ILS) in April 2011.
ADB approved the contract award for the three fire equipment in February 2012. NAC signed the contract with the selected bidder in April 2012 and commissioned the 3 Fire equipment in April 2013.
